description: Figure 4, titled "Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for MATTER and w/o material knowledge across during tokenization training different number of tokens," is a bar chart that compares the performance of the MATTER tokenizer against a baseline tokenizer without material knowledge. The chart displays two sets of bars for each of the three methods—WordPiece, SAGE, and PickyBPE—representing the Macro-F1 score for the model trained with a token count of 0.5x, 1.0x, and 1.5x the original size. The y-axis is labeled "Macro-F1 Score" and ranges from 0 to 100. For each method, the bar corresponding to the 1.5x token count shows the highest Macro-F1 score, followed by the 1.0x, and then the 0.5x. The bars for MATTER are consistently taller than the corresponding bars for the baseline method across all three token count levels, indicating that MATTER achieves higher Macro-F1 scores regardless of the number of tokens used during training. The legend indicates that the bars for MATTER are colored pink, while the bars for the baseline are colored dark purple.
